text:
sarah-support: Hi @customer-contact — we started seeing TLS handshake failures from your private deployment to our ingestion endpoint. 502s began ~0900 UTC. Any recent LB/SSL profile changes?

customer-contact: yes, we rolled an F5 config yesterday (strict profile). Errors in our proxy logs show: 
```
TLS handshake failed: SSL routines:tls_construct_server_hello:no shared cipher
```

alex-netops: Can you run this from a host in the VPC and paste output?
```
openssl s_client -connect api.private.redwood.internal:443 -servername api.redwood.internal -alpn h2 -cipher 'ECDHE+AESGCM' -brief
```

customer-contact: pasted output: 
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
write to 0x7f8f3c000000 from 0x0, ret=0
---
No peer certificate available
---
SSL routines:tls_construct_server_hello:no shared cipher
---
```

jordan-reliability: That matches a cipher-order/profile issue. Our private endpoints default to TLS1.3 + ECDHE suites; if the F5 profile forces RSA-first or disables ECDHE/TLS1.3 the server and LB can fail to agree. Also check if the F5 rewrites or strips ALPN.

alex-netops: Can you share the `tmsh` snippet for the client-ssl profile? e.g., `tmsh list ltm profile client-ssl <profile-name>`

customer-contact: snippet: 
```
ltm profile client-ssl strict-profile {
    ssl-protocols TLSv1.0 TLSv1.1 TLSv1.2
    cipher-group CUSTOM-RSA-FIRST
    disable-sslv3
}
```

sarah-support: Okay that explains it — profile is TLS1.2-only and prioritizes RSA ciphers. Two remediation options: 
1) Update the F5 profile to enable TLS1.3 and include ECDHE ciphers (recommended). Example: enable `TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3` and a cipher group containing `ECDHE-ECDSA`/`ECDHE-RSA` AESGCM suites.
2) If you cannot change the LB immediately, we can temporarily enable an RSA-compatible fallback on our side, but that increases CPU and weakens forward secrecy (not ideal).

alex-netops: Also double-check ALPN passthrough — our backend expects `h2` or `http/1.1`. If the F5 strips ALPN, it can affect protocol negotiation, though it typically shouldn't cause `no shared cipher`. Still worth confirming.

customer-contact: Trying option 1 on a canary pool in 15m, will report.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for `strict-profile-canary` 1/1 nodes.

customer-contact: Update: changed cipher group to include ECDHE suites and enabled TLS1.3 on the canary. After the change, `openssl s_client` now shows TLSv1.3 handshake and certificates. 200s returned for test requests. :tada:

jordan-reliability: Great. For mitigation doc: recommend avoiding RSA-first groups, prefer `ECDHE` curves (X25519,P-256) and TLS1.3 where possible. I'll add a KB with sample F5 profile settings.

sarah-support: Perfect — closing the ticket once KB is live. Thanks for the quick canary test, @customer-contact. :white_check_mark:
